title: SchemeCanonicalTensorShiftProperties
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], with derived category $D(\mathcal O_Y)$ [def-pc-derived-category], the recorded tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], and the canonical coherent two-variable tensor shifts [def-sc-scheme-canonical-tensor-shift]. For every $M\in D(\mathcal O_Y)$, $-\otimes^L M$ is triangulated for these shifts. If $P$ is a K-flat complex [def-pc-kflat-complex] and $K=Q(P)$, let $T=-\otimes^L\mathcal O_Y$, let $I$ be the identity with its standard shift, and let $\tau:T\to I$ be the right unitor. Then $s_T(1)_K;\tau_K[1]=\tau_{K[1]};s_I(1)_K$. No unspecified choice of tensor shifts is allowed.

source.place: K-flat total tensor translation calculation; parent representative-complex construction

proof.text: Compare the canonical independent-universe first-variable tensor shift at a K-flat representative with commShiftTensorRightQhObj by uniqueness of localized shifts. The lifting is the tensor counit whiskered with the K-flat inclusion; its shift compatibility follows from the one-variable localization comparison. Use isTriangulated_tensorRightQhObj and transport along a K-flat representative isomorphism with commShift_flip_map. Specialize to sheaves of modules. Combine this exactness with the degree-one right-unitor lemma.

theorem schemeCanonicalTensorShift_properties (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))] :
    letI := schemeCanonicalTensorShift Y
    letI : ∀ M : schemeDerivedCategory Y, (tensorRight M).CommShift ℤ :=
      fun M => Functor.CommShift₂.commShiftFlipObj (h := .int) M
    (∀ M : schemeDerivedCategory Y, (tensorRight M).IsTriangulated) ∧
      (∀ P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ,
        CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := Y.sheaf) P →
        let K := DerivedCategory.Q.obj P
        let τ := (rightUnitorNatIso (schemeDerivedCategory Y)).hom
        ((tensorRight (𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Y))).commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app K ≫
            (τ.app K)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' =
          τ.app (K⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) ≫ ((𝟭 (schemeDerivedCategory Y)).commShiftIso
            (1 : ℤ)).hom.app K)
